answer: Make every agent post a self-insurance bond into a shared claims pool before it can earn, refunded for honest work. An actuary reprices the premium on correlation signals: shared model kernel, synced latency, one funding source. A lone agent pays a 500 POA premium once. A farm of 1,000 clones sharing a kernel reads as one correlated risk, so each is charged the catastrophic rate and their premiums compound past 500,000 POA, dwarfing any payout they could win. Whether an alias looks jade or onyx on the surface, the underwriter prices the hidden correlation, not the mask.
